archetypes.name: dyn-timing-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Gate B timing is inferred from ledger row boundaries and idempotence rules.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed design timing code for ledger parsing correctness. Focus on whether the Gate B apply row starts at the intended prior vendor end, skips duplicates, preserves the round window, and avoids changing v1 vendor or round grammar. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
